Questions

Common questions.

Can tenants pay rent through M-Pesa?

Yes. Rent paid to your paybill is matched to the right unit automatically, with receipts and reminders.

Can owners see their own properties only?

Yes. Owners get a dashboard limited to their properties.

Do you build the property website too?

Yes. Listings, search and enquiry routing connect directly to the management system.
